purpose: Make authority_epoch behave as an enforceable fencing token at the Git branch mutation boundary rather than a policy-only advisory field.
contents_api_rule: Do not use per-file contents-API update_file/create_file/delete_file for authority-sensitive protected-state mutation after this policy is active, because a stale worker can otherwise update a different file after authority moved. Use one branch-head CAS packet instead.
why: A lease/epoch field is not a true fence unless stale writes are rejected at the mutation boundary. Non-force ref update of a commit whose parent is the freshly observed main head provides a repository-wide compare-and-swap: if any competing authoritative commit advances main first, the stale sibling commit cannot fast-forward main.
recovery_on_cas_conflict: Never force. Re-read main and CURRENT, verify authority again, reconstruct the intended packet against fresh state, and retry only if still authorized.
